reason: role_gated. Hyperbeat LST (beHYPE) on HyperEVM has no function anyone can call that pays the caller: the keeper family (updateExchangeRatio ~1/day, finalizeWithdrawals, depositToHyperCore/Staking, delegateTokens) is PROTOCOL_ADMIN-gated via roleRegistry.hasRole and eth_call from a fresh EOA reverts 0xea8e4eb5 NotAuthorized(); the only permissionless functions are user actions (stake, withdraw, claimWithdrawal) whose money goes to the user/treasury, never to a stranger calling on someone's behalf. One operator EOA runs the daily ratio update and pays its own gas; nothing to harvest.
